EX-99.1 2 tm2628699d1_ex99-1.htm EXHIBIT 99.1 Exhibit 99.1 uniQure Announces FDA Acceptance and Priority Review of the Biologics License Application for ifezuntirgene inilparvovec for the Treatment of Huntington’s Disease ~ FDA sets PDUFA target action date of May 1, 2027 ~ ~ If approved, ifezuntirgene inilparvovec will be the world’s first disease-modifying treatment for Huntington’s disease ~ Lexington, MA and Amsterdam, the Netherlands, November 2, 2026 — uniQure N.V.
The application has been granted Priority Review with a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date of May 1, 2027.
In its acceptance letter, the FDA stated that they are tentatively planning to discuss this application at an Advisory Committee meeting.

Examples of these forward-looking statements include, but are not limited to, statements concerning: the Company’s beliefs related to the review and approval of its biologics license application (“BLA”) for ifezuntirgene inilparvovec; expectations regarding the adequacy of clinical data to support the marketing application and approval of ifezuntirgene inilparvovec; expectations regarding timing of receiving potential approval of, ifezuntirgene inilparvovec; whether the FDA will hold an advisory committee to discuss the BLA and the timing of such review and approval based on the Prescription Drug User Fee Act (“PDUFA”) target action date of May 1, 2027 for the BLA; and its belief related to the potential for ifezuntirgene inilparvovec, if approved, to meaningfully reduce disease progression based on the Company’s evaluation and view of certain measurements of disease progression.
